C0.loc: Section 1 Introduction, p. 2; Section 3 The model, p. 7
C0.quote: a planner awards a single, indivisible, prize to one of n competing agents
C0.note: The main object is optimal mechanism design without money for allocating a single prize. Agents report binary signals about their own suitability, and the planner maximises the probability of picking a suitable agent using external referee signals. This is an allocation and screening problem (cf. costly-verification and assignment literature), not a procedure aggregating agents' inputs into a collective decision by voting. A secondary peer-evaluation section resembles impartial peer selection, but most main results (Theorem 1, Propositions 1, 4, 5) concern self-reports of private types. Coding stopped per C0.
